official_measurement_examples.name: NUAR operational status
official_measurement_examples.fact: GOV.UK records NUAR as operational from December 2025 and operated by Ordnance Survey on behalf of GDS.

official_measurement_examples.name: Asset-owner scale
official_measurement_examples.fact: Current GOV.UK guidance says NUAR provides secure access to data from over 600 public and private sector asset owners.

official_measurement_examples.name: Statutory footing
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 received Royal Assent on 19 June 2025 and establishes the statutory framework for NUAR through amendments to street-works legislation.

official_measurement_examples.name: Tranche 1 consultation status
official_measurement_examples.fact: The tranche-1 regulations consultation closed in October 2025; proposals in the consultation are not treated as enacted secondary legislation without later evidence.

official_measurement_examples.name: Safe-dig purpose
official_measurement_examples.fact: NUAR is designed to support safer and more efficient works around buried pipes cables and other apparatus.

official_measurement_examples.name: Security limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: NPSA advises limiting underground-asset data access to the extent necessary and warns against using potentially outdated information for decision-making.

official_measurement_examples.name: Street works permission separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: DfT section-50 guidance states other permissions such as planning permission can still be required depending on the work.

official_measurement_examples.name: Programme reporting
official_measurement_examples.fact: DSIT's 2026-27 estimate memorandum reports the NUAR programme baseline ending 31 March 2026; programme status is not evidence that every asset record is complete or current.
